				‘We are being hampered’ by Brexit deal: UK Foreign minister

									
						
						
						Krishnan Guru-Murthy
						
						Presenter
					
				
				
			
		
		  
			
				We spoke to Stephen Doughty, a minister of state at the Foreign office and who spent two years as Europe minister.

We asked him what these new improvements in the relationship between the EU will do for British businesses.
